name: Small-Lower-Support Switch Controls
definition: The 68-concept switch base has section sizes $|D|=|E|=11$ and $|U|=57$, so both sides have the same positive endpoint by the peripheral case. Two further fixed nonperipheral switches attach a three-concept lower square: one has two positive endpoints, while both sides of the other contract root-preservingly onto a known bad rooted factor and both endpoints fail.
properties: These controls realize both common signs of the small-lower-support criterion. None changes the endpoint, confirming that a changing rooted switch must have rank-at-least-three supports exclusive to both sections.
